data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Xara means ‘new fragrance’. In Greek mythology, Xara was a nymph who bestowed the gift of new fragrances upon the earth. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Xara usually hope their child will grow to embody new fragrance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
